SELECT input_table.employee_name, input_table.job_title, input_table.department, input_table.annual_salary, input_table.location, cost_of_living.cost_of_living_index
FROM input_table
INNER JOIN cost_of_living ON input_table.location = cost_of_living.location
ORDER BY cost_of_living.cost_of_living_index DESC
